name: Antique Furniture
description: Screen: A kind of furniture used to block the wind inside buildings in ancient times. The so-called "wind screen". As an important part of traditional furniture, screens have a long history. Screens are generally displayed in prominent positions indoors to play a role in separation, beautification, wind protection, coordination, etc. The armchair is a traditional armchair with a special form. This chair is made into a semicircle according to the human body structure and is very comfortable to sit on. The Ming-style armchair is generally plain without carvings and has a simple and beautiful shape. It is a fine piece of furniture loved by literati.
